hypotheses.title: Explicit NP General-Circuit Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial-time decidable and polynomially balanced NP relation V(x,w) whose language L_V requires Boolean circuits of size n^omega(1).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Since every language in P has polynomial-size circuits, this would imply L_V is not in P and therefore P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_TARGET: convert an explicit NP verification problem into a superpolynomial nonuniform lower bound.
hypotheses.next_gate: Select a concrete NP language and a lower-bound measure that survives natural-proofs and relativization audits.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-size circuit family deciding every candidate language selected by a sharpened descendant.
A proof that the proposed candidate relation collapses to P.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Polynomially Constructible SAT Anti-Checker Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every constant k there is a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, on input 1^n, outputs a list S_n of poly(n) CNF formulas of length n such that every Boolean circuit C of size n^k purporting to decide SAT errs on at least one formula in S_n, and every claimed error is polynomial-time checkable from an accompanying SAT witness or resolution-style unsatisfiability certificate.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would give an explicit diagonalization against n^k-size SAT circuits for every k and hence SAT not in P/poly, implying P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: turn circuit lower bounds for SAT into finite, independently checkable anti-checker objects.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define an unsatisfiability certificate class strong enough for the construction but weak enough to verify deterministically in polynomial time.
falsification_conditions: A size n^k SAT circuit correct on all formulas in the produced list for infinitely many n.
A proof that constructing the required certified negative examples is as hard as solving arbitrary coNP instances without additional structure.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Witnessing-Formula Extended-Frege Bridge Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a polynomial-time computable function f and constant k such that the witnessing formulas w_n^k(f) are tautologies and require n^omega(1)-size proofs in Extended Frege augmented by all substitution instances of w_n^k(f) of smaller lengths.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: By the witnessing-formula framework, the resulting proof lower bound would imply that SAT requires superpolynomial Boolean circuits and therefore P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: reduce P != NP to a concrete strong proof-complexity lower bound with a verified tautologicity premise.
hypotheses.next_gate: Choose an explicit f, prove tautologicity without assuming the desired circuit lower bound, and identify a lower-bound invariant for the augmented system.
falsification_conditions: Polynomial-size proofs for all w_n^k(f) in the exact augmented system.
Failure of tautologicity for every explicit candidate f covered by the statement.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Nisan-Wigderson Generator Hardness for Extended Frege Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist an explicit NP intersect coNP Boolean function f that is exponentially hard on average for polynomial-size circuits and an explicit Nisan-Wigderson design A such that every tautology expressing b not in Range(NW_{f,A}) requires superpolynomial Extended Frege proofs.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would provide an explicit hard tautology family for Extended Frege, implying NP != coNP and hence P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PROOF_COMPLEXITY_ROUTE: obtain NP != coNP from generator tautologies tied to an independently meaningful hardness assumption.
hypotheses.next_gate: Replace the assumed average-case circuit hardness of f by an unconditional theorem or derive the EF lower bound from a weaker checkable property.
falsification_conditions: Polynomial-size Extended Frege proofs for all range-avoidance tautologies of the selected generator.
A proof that no explicit NP intersect coNP function can satisfy the required average-case hardness.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Strong One-Bit Proof-Complexity Generator Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial-time function g:{0,1}^n to {0,1}^{n+1} whose range intersects every infinite NP set.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: For such a generator, the associated range-avoidance tautologies are hard for every propositional proof system; this would rule out a polynomially bounded proof system and imply NP != coNP, hence P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_UNIVERSAL_ROUTE: compress the absence of all polynomially bounded proof systems into one explicit generator property.
hypotheses.next_gate: Give a concrete generator and prove the hitting property for arbitrary infinite NP sets without assuming NP != coNP.
falsification_conditions: An infinite NP set disjoint from the range of every candidate generator selected by a descendant.
A theorem that every polynomial-time one-bit-stretch function misses some infinite NP set.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Extended-Frege Circuit-Rewriting Chain Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible family of equivalent circuit pairs (C_n,D_n) such that every chain C_n=E_0 approximately E_1 approximately ... approximately E_t=D_n under the polynomial-time local relation of Krajicek 2026 has length n^omega(1).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Because a size-s Extended Frege proof of C_n equivalent D_n induces a chain of length s^O(1), this would give a superpolynomial Extended Frege lower bound and imply NP != coNP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: replace opaque EF proof lower bounds by a combinatorial lower bound on an explicit local circuit-rewriting graph.
hypotheses.next_gate: Identify an invariant that changes only polynomially per approximately-step but differs superpolynomially between explicit equivalent endpoints.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-length approximately-chain for every explicit candidate pair.
A theorem that all equivalent polynomial-size circuit pairs are connected by polynomial-length approximately-chains.

hypotheses.title: P-Inseparability of the Extended-Frege Canonical Pair Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: The canonical disjoint NP pair associated with Extended Frege is not separable by any polynomial-time language.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: If P=NP then all disjoint NP pairs are polynomial-time separable, so this would imply P != NP; it would also expose a concrete search barrier tied to strong proof systems.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PAIR_ROUTE: prove P != NP by separating a canonical pair rather than lower-bounding all EF proofs directly.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the canonical-pair encoding and derive a reduction from a standard hard disjoint pair or a communication lower-bound invariant.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-time separator for the exact canonical pair.
A theorem placing both sides of the pair in a common polynomial-time decidable separator.

hypotheses.title: Boolean-CNF Full-IPS Lower-Bound Transfer Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit Boolean CNF family F_n and an explicit polynomial family h_n such that every full IPS refutation of F_n over GF(2) can be transformed with polynomial overhead into an algebraic circuit computing h_n, while h_n requires n^omega(1) algebraic circuit size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would yield a full-IPS lower bound on Boolean CNFs; by the IPS framework it would imply a major algebraic circuit lower bound and rule out polynomial boundedness of full IPS for the family.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGEBRAIC_BRIDGE: turn an explicit algebraic circuit lower bound into a Boolean proof-complexity lower bound.
hypotheses.next_gate: Choose h_n in a circuit class where a lower bound is within reach and prove the extraction for unrestricted IPS circuits.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-size full-IPS refutation whose extracted circuit avoids computing h_n.
A failure of the extraction map on unrestricted circuit reuse or Boolean axioms.

hypotheses.title: PIT-Axiom Hardness Resolution Conjecture for AC0[p]-Frege
hypotheses.statement: For some fixed prime p and constant depth d, either AC0[p]-Frege requires superpolynomial proofs of the depth-d PIT axioms, or every polynomial-size depth-d PIT circuit family yields an explicit VNP polynomial requiring superpolynomial depth-d algebraic circuits by a uniform extraction.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Either branch supplies a major lower bound: the first directly separates a bounded-depth Frege system, while the second gives an explicit algebraic circuit lower bound that feeds IPS and proof-complexity routes.
hypotheses.proof_role: WIN_WIN_BRIDGE: force progress by making the PIT-axiom dichotomy constructive on both branches.
hypotheses.next_gate: Formalize the extraction with explicit uniformity and coefficient bounds, then identify a candidate PIT family whose axioms are concrete.
falsification_conditions: A model in which PIT axioms have short AC0[p]-Frege proofs but no extractable algebraic lower bound under the stated uniformity.
A flaw in the proposed exhaustive dichotomy between the two branches.

hypotheses.title: Deterministic Polynomial Identity Testing Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that decides whether an explicitly represented arithmetic circuit over the integers computes the zero polynomial.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: By the Kabanets-Impagliazzo framework, this yields a major Boolean or arithmetic circuit lower bound; those lower bounds provide indispensable input to IPS and nonuniform routes toward P versus NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: derandomize PIT and thereby force a circuit lower-bound disjunction.
hypotheses.next_gate: Construct a hitting set generator with polynomial seed enumeration or prove a structural reduction to a tractable circuit class.
falsification_conditions: A proof that deterministic PIT requires superpolynomial time.
An unconditional obstruction ruling out polynomial-size hitting sets for general arithmetic circuits.
